name: locale-lint-monorepo
description: Monorepo for @digitalby/locale-lint and its language-family plugins.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @digitalby/locale-lint && npm run build -w @digitalby/locale-lint-chinese
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @digitalby/locale-lint && npm run lint -w @digitalby/locale-lint-chinese
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @digitalby/locale-lint && npm run test -w @digitalby/locale-lint-chinese

author: digitalby <yury@digitalby.me>
